writing.exampleCaption: No allocation, and the result cannot outlive its input.
writing.explanation: A slice stores a pointer and a length but owns nothing, so creating one allocates no memory. Because it borrows, the compiler will not let it outlive the String or array it points into, which rules out a dangling view.
writing.feedback: The returned &str borrows from text, so it cannot outlive it.
